title: Wisdom of Solomon — Instructions and Commands
content:
Wisdom of Solomon — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

9 additional passage records · 10 quoted verse units. Read Wisdom of Solomon in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Worship, prayer and holy things · Justice, truth and protection · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct · Work, possessions and stewardship

Worship, prayer and holy things

Uncertain · 1 passage records

Wisdom of Solomon 16:28

Record type: Wisdom instruction. Source section: Heavenly food and grateful dependence.

Wisdom of Solomon 16:28 — so that it might be known that one must rise before the sun to give Thee thanks and appeal to Thee at the rising of the light.

Context and scope: Wisdom counsel in its original setting. Continuing application and any correspondence with the New Testament are not automatically assigned.
